wLineRecord.derivation: Candidates tested in list order. Panthenol@11, Tocopherol@12, Biotin@13 and Tocopheryl Acetate@15 (class c) each have a cleansing surfactant before them (i) but Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate@33 after them before the cap, so (ii) fails. Phenoxyethanol@40 (class b): Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate@2 before it; between 40 and the cap 45 only Chlorphenesin, Potassium Sorbate, Sodium Benzoate, Citric Acid (no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax) -> plausible. No alphabetical run of >=7 entries.

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: there is no prominent strong anionic (C4); the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate@2, and a prominent amphoteric co-surfactant is present (Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine@5). Counter-signal: the chassis is anionic-dominated - four prominent mild anionics (Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate@2, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate@3, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate@6, Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate@33) against one amphoteric, plus the booster Cocamide MIPA@4; this lowers confidence to moderate (neighbor moderate) but never moves the convention value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high: C2 is met - early (prominent, E3 point 45) silicone Amodimethicone@30 (plus Silicone Quaternium-18@31), cationic polymer Polyquaternium-10@37, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate@7 and deliberate humectants Glycerin@8 / Panthenol@11; further routes Cetrimonium Chloride@29, Quaternium-95@32, prominent payload lipids Shea Butter@19, Evening Primrose Oil@20, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil@24, Jojoba Esters@25 and Hydrolyzed Milk Protein@26. Counter-signal: every conditioning route except Glycol Distearate and Glycerin is listed after typical sub-1 % vitamins (Panthenol@11, Biotin@13), and the E3 point sits unusually late (after the preservatives), so the actual amounts may be small; confidence moderate, neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: high: a rich architecture (W-RICH) with limited reset - material payload lipids (Shea Butter@19, Evening Primrose Oil@20, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil@24, Jojoba Esters@25, all before the W-line Phenoxyethanol@40) converge with persistent silicone/cationic deposition (Amodimethicone@30, Silicone Quaternium-18@31, Cetrimonium Chloride@29, Quaternium-95@32, Polyquaternium-10@37) in a mild C6 chassis (resetCapacity weak). The convergence route also holds independently (silicone + cationic_conditioner + cationic_polymer + payload_lipid + protein_film). Confidence moderate (neighbor moderate) because all deposition routes sit after typical sub-1 % actives.

weightPotential.counterevidence: All deposition families are listed after Panthenol@11 and Biotin@13, i.e. in a zone that INCI order suggests is low-concentration; the late cleansing surfactant Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate@33 and the silicone-emulsion emulsifiers (Trideceth-6/-12) suggest the list tail is not strictly descending, so amounts cannot be bounded either way.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Five deposition families converge, including amino-functional silicone, a silicone quat, two cationic conditioners and a cationic polymer that deposit at low dose, plus material butters/oils (W-LINE gate passed); W-RICH holds and the mild isethionate/sulfosuccinate/sulfoacetate + sultaine chassis gives only weak reset, which satisfies the high anchor rich route.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would require evidence that reset offsets the converging systems or that richness is absent; the chassis is mild (C6 low) and the lipid leg is material under W-LINE, so the late listing is the only argument for moderate and INCI order cannot prove trace amounts (P0: the lighter band is the recommending direction).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Actual concentrations of the late-listed deposition routes are unknown (they follow sub-1 % vitamins); a closer-to-trace reading would argue moderate.
weightPotential.counterSignal: All deposition families are listed after Panthenol@11 and Biotin@13, i.e. in a zone that INCI order suggests is low-concentration; the late cleansing surfactant Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate@33 and the silicone-emulsion emulsifiers (Trideceth-6/-12) suggest the list tail is not strictly descending, so amounts cannot be bounded either way.
